title: Used Car Purchase Checklist
subtitle: Walkaround, test drive, paperwork, and PPI — buy with a cool head and a coach in your pocket.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel. Phase 2 used car: never skip PPI on expensive buys; flood/salvage caution.

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Used EV: demand battery health report / range test, check for HV warnings, and confirm 12V age. Prefer EV-capable PPI.
Used Tesla: review service history in-app if possible, check for structural repair clues, and verify Autopilot hardware claims in writing.
CVT-equipped used cars: prioritize transmission behavior cold/hot and service records — budget for specialist PPI.
High-mile purchase: PPI is non-negotiable. Timing belt, rust, and leak history matter more than shiny paint.
